messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary alert — hawthorn-vpc/canary-7f2 exceeded 5xx threshold (18%) and token latency spikes. Auto-rollout paused.

sre-bot: Incident thread created for hawthorn-enterprise - dedicated/VPC canary. Paging on-call.

alex: I'm on-call. seeing timeouts from the canary tasks hitting model-serving kernel with OOM-ish traces. grabbing logs now.

jamie: looking at daemons — tasks in pool dedicated-hawthorn-1 entering crashloop on 202 -> kernel call failures. stack traces show `kv-cache miss -> memfrag`.

dan: quick question — was this canary using pinned artifact `hawthorn-artifact@sha256:9c7a` or the newly promoted `hawthorn-artifact@sha256:bf21`?

luis: It was the new one (`bf21`). I can try pinning back to `9c7a` if we want immediate mitigation.

alex: yes pinback to `9c7a` for the canary only. Do NOT touch prod pools yet. We need to confirm impact and scope first. @cs-lynn notify customer comms.

cs-lynn: notifying Hawthorn CSM and legal. sending initial note: "We see elevated errors on canary, isolating, will update within 30 mins." :email: 

jamie: command to pinback canary artifact:
```
redwoodctl deploy set-artifact --env hawthorn-vpc --pool canary-7f2 --artifact hawthorn-artifact@sha256:9c7a
redwoodctl rollout status --env hawthorn-vpc --pool canary-7f2
```
I'll run it now.

jamie: running pinback now — pausing traffic to canary, swapping artifact.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout event: canary-7f2 pinned to hawthorn-artifact@sha256:9c7a at 2056001012 — status: in-progress.

alex: monitoring latency and 5xx metrics. if errors drop to <3% in 10m, keep pinned and then plan a safe prod rollout or deeper investigation.

dan: we should also enable a fallback model variant in the routing policy for this tenant to avoid user-facing errors: set `route_fallback: small-llm-v1` for hawthorn tenant id 4873.

luis: applied fallback routing for tenant 4873. command:
```
redwoodctl routing set-fallback --tenant 4873 --variant small-llm-v1
```

sre-bot: Observability update: 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 4.6% over 8m after pinback. Token p95 latency reduced from 2200ms -> 420ms.

alex: good. keep pinned for now. next steps: 1) run memory-profiling on `bf21` artifact in isolated env, 2) capture heap snapshots, 3) coord with eng-runtime for kernel regressions, 4) prepare rollback playbook if we need to revert prod.

jack: I see a regression in wasm-kernel allocation path in `bf21`—we introduced a lazy-kv-cache change. reproducing locally now. will post PR link once we confirm.

dan: estimate customer impact: canary serves ~2% of Hawthorn traffic — production unaffected at the moment. However multi-tenant requests to dedicated pool could be affected if rollout continued. Good call to pinback.

cs-lynn: drafting update to Hawthorn: "We isolated and pinned the canary artifact; impact limited to canary traffic; engineering is investigating; will follow up with root cause and timeline." sending now.

maria: I will take second-watch from 02:00 UTC. I'll validate the pinned canary for 30m and then run a staged smoke test for prod if green. @alex handing off.

alex: handing over to maria — summary: pinback to 9c7a succeeded, error rate back to baseline, fallback routing in place for tenant 4873, eng-runtime investigating `bf21` kernel kv-cache change. contact points: jamie (ops), jack (eng-runtime), luis (routing), cs-lynn (customer).

maria: ack — I'll keep this thread updated. escalations -> paging pager duty if 5xx > 5% for 15m or p95 > 1500ms. I'll also coordinate postmortem if RCA required.

sre-bot: Incident mode: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned to oncall-maria for watch window until 2056013200.

cs-lynn: customer updated at 2056001400. they'll expect a follow-up with RCA and plan within 24h.

alex: thanks team. quick note — keep artifact `bf21` quarantined in registry with tag `quarantine/bf21` until eng-runtime completes analysis.

luis: quarantined via `registryctl tag hawthorn-artifact@sha256:bf21 quarantine/bf21` — confirmed.

maria: closing active mitigation steps. will re-open if metrics regress. :white_check_mark:
